_readme: Teachings catalogue. Three licence tiers, never mixed in the UI.
'public-domain'  quotable text, author dead 70+ years, safe to reproduce.
'licensed'       text a rights-holder has given written permission for.
Put the permission on file before adding anything here.
'link-only'      NO text stored. An embed or link to the speaker's own
official channel. The video stays on YouTube; views and
ads go to the ministry. This is the tier for any living
or recent preacher you have not licensed.
Only ever embed from a ministry's OWN verified channel. Fan re-uploads are
themselves infringing and get removed, leaving dead players in your app.
